label: Final

coverage.text: Fall 2026 Final (Fri 12/18, 11:30am–2:30pm, 75 points, paper). The course pages don’t state its scope; this option assumes the whole course, using the course’s in-scope topic list.

scope.note: Problems are included when every topic the course staff tagged them with is on the course’s current in-scope topic list (no Scheme, macros or tail recursion). That classification is this site’s, not a staff recommendation.

noPicks: Course staff haven’t published final exam question picks, so nothing is marked recommended.

timed.intro: Each exam draws original past exam problems from the whole course at random and balances them across topics: early material, recursion and lists, trees/objects/iterators/efficiency, and SQL. The 50-minute exam draws 3 problems from different topic groups. No more than one problem comes from the same source exam when there’s a choice. They aren’t modified, so you may have seen some of them.

exams.note: Last fall’s final, from the same instructors.

61a-fa25-final/5.t: Classified by this site: the course staff haven’t tagged this asynchronous-programming problem. It was on the Fall 2025 final (same instructors), but the Fall 2026 course pages don’t confirm coroutines are on this final.
